thread:
Renee: quick alert after the 04:00 deploy 1: small spike in small-batch tail for completions in ap-southeast-1. p99 crossed our auto-rollback threshold for 3 mins. not widespread but enough to trigger concern
Arjun: saw it. traces point to small-batch scheduling jitter on newer kernel build. affected hosts are a narrow subset.
Felix: recommend preventing autopilot flip while we triage. can we set a short safety mutex and either pin affected hosts to previous runtime or kill-slice for tiny batches?
deploy-bot: autopilot rollback window active for r=2026.09.02-0400. To suppress automatic rollback set `--safety-mutex locked`. Scoped mitigations: `traffic-pin --hosts <hostlist> --version <v>` or `batch-policy set --max-small-batch-size <n>`
Renee: locking safety mutex for 20m to buy time. I'll try a low-risk batch-policy change on the affected pool first.
Arjun: running `batch-policy set --pool=comp-workers-aps --max-small-batch-size=4 --reason="small-batch-jitter-mitigation"`
Felix: policy applied. immediate telemetry shows the p99 dropping on the affected hosts. overall region p99 down ~60% from spike.
Nora: product note ready, keeping customer message in standby. will publish only if we pin or rollback.
Renee: consensus: no full rollback. keep mutex until we monitor for 30m total from mitigation, then unpin and re-enable autopilot. adding follow-up: revert experimental kernel flag and add nightly test for small-batch scheduling.
deploy-bot: noted. safety-mutex locked by Renee until 1746002311. autopilot suppressed until that time unless changed.
Felix: adding runbook entry: 1) safety-mutex locked; 2) batch-policy tweak applied; 3) no manual rollback performed; 4) follow-up: revert kernel experiment and add unit test.
Renee: thanks team. will post summary to #support and link release note draft: https://company.docs/release-notes/2026-09-02-small-batch-mitigation :thumbsup:
